ranked.rationale: Direct compile-scoped logging library used in DiscountCalculator.java. CVE-2021-44228 (Log4Shell) is CVSS 10.0 and allows unauthenticated remote code execution via JNDI lookup in crafted log messages. Three additional CVEs in the same family bring total count to 4. Banded HIGH (CRITICAL CVE floor applied). Upgrade to 2.17.1+ immediately.

Direct compile-scoped Log4j2 API module, part of the same vulnerable Log4j2 family as log4j-core. CVE-2021-44228 (CVSS 10.0) and CVE-2021-45046 (CVSS 9.0) apply. Applications pairing this with log4j-core are exposed to Log4Shell. Upgrade to 2.17.1+ as a unit with log4j-core.

Direct compile-scoped JSON deserialization library with 53 known vulnerabilities including 9.8 CVSS remote code execution via polymorphic deserialization gadget chains. Version 2.9.8 is deeply outdated (current: 2.18.x). High density bonus boosts cve_severity to 10.0. Upgrade to 2.15.4+ (or latest 2.18.x). Business criticality defaults to 2 as no import found in src — but any route that deserializes user-controlled JSON is exposed.

TYPOSQUATTED dependency: groupId 'com.fastxml.jackson.core' is missing 'er', impersonating the legitimate 'com.fasterxml.jackson.core'. This artifact does not exist on Maven Central and will fail to resolve — but if it did resolve (e.g. from the declared untrusted HTTP mirror), it could deliver arbitrary malicious code. REMOVE immediately. cve_severity set to 8.0 as a supply-chain critical-risk proxy.

Direct compile-scoped JDBC driver carrying CVE-2023-22102 (CVSS 8.3, network-accessible compromise of MySQL Connectors). Additionally, the GPL-2.0 license violates this project's permissive-license policy — usage may require open-sourcing the entire application. No patched version available for 8.0.x; replace with 'com.mysql:mysql-connector-j' (commercial exception) or a permissively-licensed alternative.

Severely outdated version (2.4, current 2.18.0). CVE-2024-47554 (CVSS 7.5, network DoS via XmlStreamReader uncontrolled resource consumption) and CVE-2021-29425 (path traversal, CVSS 4.8) both apply. Version 2.4 is over a decade old. Density bonus raises cve_severity to 8.0. Upgrade to 2.14.0+ (fixes both CVEs).
Outdated version (3.4, current 3.18.0). CVE-2025-48924 (CVSS 6.5, network-triggered infinite loop / DoS). Upgrade to 3.18.0 to remediate.

CVE-2018-10237 (CVSS 5.9, unbounded memory allocation DoS via deserialization) and CVE-2020-8908 (CVSS 3.3, insecure temp dir). Density bonus raises cve_severity from 5.9 to 6.4. Upgrade to 33.x-jre to remediate both.
Test-scoped JUnit 5 framework with no known CVEs. Low exposure (test/provided +1 vs compile +3). No production risk. Minor upgrade available (5.12.x).

supply_chain_findings.remediation: Remove dependency block immediately. The legitimate artifact is already declared as com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-databind:2.9.8.
Remove the 'internal-untrusted-mirror' <repository> block from pom.xml. This plain-HTTP, unverified mirror enables MITM artifact poisoning.
Replace with com.mysql:mysql-connector-j (commercial license exception) or org.mariadb.jdbc:mariadb-java-client (LGPL).
